simple.meaning: properly, (abstractly) a raising (as of the hands in prayer), or rising (of flame); figuratively, an utterance ; concretely, a beacon (as raised); a present (as taken), mess , or tribute ; figuratively, a reproach (as a burden)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַשְׂאֵת (H4864) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 16 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.

definitions.full: H4864. maseth מַשְׂאֵת noun feminine uprising, utterance, burden, portion (on formation compare Ol § 109 a Sta § 272 b Kö ii. 1, 183 ; Phoenician (Pun) has משאת = payment, tax see Lzb 326 ); — absolute ׳מ Judg 20:40 +; construct מַשְׂאַת Gen 43:34 +; plural absolute מַשְׂאֹת 43:34 , + (probably) מַשְׂאוֺת Lam 2:14 (see below); construct מַשְׂאֹת Gen 43:34 ; — 1 that which rises, uprising, uplifting: a. ׳מ הֶעָשָׁן Judg 20:38 uprising of smoke , compare ( ׳הֶע omitted) 20:40 . b. in General = signal Jer 6:1 (= נֵס Gf.). c. uplifting of hands ( כַּמַּי ) in prayer Psa 141:2 (|| תְּפִלָּה ). 2 utterance, oracle (= III. מַשָּׂא ), Lam 2:14 (Bu Löhr). 3 burden Zeph 3:18 (of reproach, figurative). 4. a. portion (carried to some one), especially from table of king or superior, Gen 43:34 (3 t. in verse) (J; on custom see Di and references), 2Sam 11:8 ; so read perhaps also 19:43 (for נִשֵּׂאת ᵑ0 ) Gr HPS. b. perhaps also more Generally, present, largess from a superior Jer 40:5 ( + אֲרֻחָה food-allowance ), Est 2:18 ( הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּיַד ). c. exacted or enforced gift , from inferior, ׳מ בַּר Amos 5:11 (compare Phoenician above; see also מנחה ). d. sacred contribution, tax ׳מ משֶׁה ( ׳י ) עֶבֶד 2Chr 24:6 , 9 . e. offering to ׳י Ezek 20:40 .
